en.headline: Housing Bureau says public housing composite waiting time falls to 4.4 years
en.dek: The figure is the lowest in a decade and the first time below the 4.5-year target set for 2026-27, the bureau said on Friday.
body: The Housing Bureau announced on Friday that the latest composite waiting time for subsidised rental housing stood at 4.4 years as at the end of September 2026.

This is down 0.4 years from 4.8 years at the end of June and 1.7 years shorter than the 6.1-year peak before the current-term government took office. It is the lowest in ten years and the first time the figure has fallen below 4.5 years.

The composite waiting time measures the average wait of general applicants — family and elderly one-person applicants — who were allocated traditional public rental housing or Light Public Housing units in the previous 12 months.

A bureau spokesman said the decline reflected sustained increases in public housing production and the progressive completion of projects, which were clearing long-standing backlogs. The bureau said it was confident of meeting the 2022 Policy Address target of reducing the time to 4.5 years in 2026-27.

In the third quarter of 2026 about 11,200 general applicants were housed, including roughly 3,100 newly completed public rental units, 2,700 recovered units and 5,450 Light Public Housing units. Over the past 12 months the average wait for those given traditional public rental housing was 5.3 years, while those allocated Light Public Housing waited 2.8 years on average.
As at the end of September there were about 96,100 general applications pending, down nearly 40 per cent from the 2020 peak and the lowest in 15 years.

zh.headline: 房屋局公布公屋綜合輪候時間降至4.4年 創十年新低
zh.dek: 較6月底的4.8年減少0.4年，首次低於4.5年目標，亦是過去十年來最低。
body: 房屋局周五公布，截至2026年9月底，最新公屋綜合輪候時間為4.4年。
數字較今年6月底的4.8年下降0.4年，較本屆政府上任前的高位6.1年縮短1.7年，是過去十年來新低，亦是首次低於4.5年。
綜合輪候時間是根據過去12個月獲編配傳統公共租住房屋或簡約公屋的一般申請者（家庭申請者及長者一人申請者）的平均輪候時間計算。
房屋局發言人表示，總體公營房屋建屋量持續增加，各個項目陸續落成，長期積壓的輪候個案逐漸被消化，輪候時間呈下降趨勢。局方有信心達到2022年《施政報告》提出在2026/27年度降至4.5年的目標。
今年第3季約有11,200宗一般申請獲安排入住，包括約3,100個新落成傳統公屋單位、約2,700個回收單位及約5,450個簡約公屋單位。過去12個月入住傳統公屋的平均輪候時間為5.3年，獲編配簡約公屋者平均為2.8年。
截至9月底，一般申請約有96,100宗，較2020年高峰大幅減少近四成，為過去15年新低。
